en.title: Event system

sections.heading: Listen for an event
Emit an event
sections.body:
```ts ignore-check
ctx.emit('event-name', payload)
```

sections.heading: Event modes
sections.body: Cordis provides several event modes for different interaction contracts.

sections.heading: emit — broadcast
bail — short circuit
serial — ordered execution
sections.body:
Listeners run in registration order and asynchronous results are awaited. The first listener to return a non-empty value stops further execution:

```ts ignore-check
await ctx.serial('setup-phase', context)
```

sections.heading: waterfall — pipeline
Typed events
Cordis events and session records
sections.body:
Harness Cordis events use `namespace/action` names, including `agent/step`, `agent/request`, `agent/request-error`, `tools/result`, and `session/event`. The generated `cordis-surface` regions on the [subsystem pages](../../../subsystems/core.md) record complete signatures and modes.

`turn/*`, `step/*`, `tool/call`, `tool/result`, and `compact/*` are durable session-event types, not same-named Cordis events. To observe them, listen to `session/event` and inspect `event.type`.

sections.heading: Event listeners are effects
Example: logging plugin
sections.body:
This plugin logs tool calls and results:

```ts
import type { Context } from '@deepseek-ai/cordis'
import '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools'

export const name = 'tool-logger'

export function apply(ctx: Context) {
  ctx.on('tools/result', (exec, result) => {
    console.log(`[tool] ${exec.name}(${JSON.stringify(exec.arguments)})`)
    const text = result.content
      .map(block => block.type === 'text' ? block.text : '')
      .join('')
    console.log(`[tool result] ${text.slice(0, 100)}`)
  })
}
```

触发事件
sections.body:

sections.heading: 事件模式
sections.body: Cordis 提供多种事件模式，适用于不同的交互约定：

sections.heading: emit — 广播
bail — 短路
serial — 顺序执行
sections.body:
监听器按注册顺序依次执行，并等待异步结果；第一个返回非空值的监听器会终止后续执行：

```ts ignore-check
await ctx.serial('setup-phase', context)
```

sections.heading: waterfall（瀑布式事件）— 流水线
类型安全的事件
Cordis 事件与会话记录
sections.body:
Harness 的 Cordis 事件遵循 `namespace/action` 命名，例如 `agent/step`、`agent/request`、`agent/request-error`、`tools/result` 和 `session/event`。完整签名与触发模式见[子系统页面](../../../subsystems/core.md)上生成的 `cordis-surface` 区块。

`turn/*`、`step/*`、`tool/call`、`tool/result` 和 `compact/*` 是持久化的会话事件类型，不是同名 Cordis 事件。需要观察它们时，监听 `session/event` 并检查 `event.type`。

sections.heading: 事件监听器也是效果
示例：日志插件
sections.body:
这个插件记录工具调用和工具结果：

```ts
import type { Context } from '@deepseek-ai/cordis'
import '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools'

export const name = 'tool-logger'

export function apply(ctx: Context) {
  ctx.on('tools/result', (exec, result) => {
    console.log(`[tool] ${exec.name}(${JSON.stringify(exec.arguments)})`)
    const text = result.content
      .map(block => block.type === 'text' ? block.text : '')
      .join('')
    console.log(`[tool result] ${text.slice(0, 100)}`)
  })
}
```
